summary: Frontend-only theme compliance validation for RealAICoach v2 light/dark. Verified pricing, /auth/login, /auth/register, /features/fps-game, /features/flappy-bird, /content-library, /dashboard (redirected root), /settings render correctly in BOTH themes with correct semantic tokens (light body-bg rgb(248,250,252); dark body-bg rgb(5,10,24)). Login flow with admin credentials succeeded end-to-end (redirect to home dashboard) in dark mode. Pricing plan cards render with visible borders, hero/plan/matrix/ROI/FAQ sections readable in both modes, no invisible text. Mobile 390px on pricing and welcome shows zero horizontal overflow. No JS pageerrors recorded across any tested route. Only console noise is expected /api/auth/me 401 pre-auth bootstrap and benign react-native useNativeDriver JS-fallback warning (pre-existing, not theme related).
critical_code_review_comments: Theme-build-gate is WARN-only (62 -> 15 warns after fix); recommend upgrading to FAIL threshold once 15 remaining warns are triaged, so future hex-color regressions are blocked pre-merge instead of relying on manual audits.

FPS/Flappy/ContentLibrary routes rendered with identical text length (16597 chars) as protected shell -- observed that unauthenticated visits fall through the auth shell; theme still renders correctly, but consider a lighter public-preview vs dashboard-shell split if these are intended as public feature landing pages.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL https://visa-polish-v2.preview.emergentagent.com works for headless browser (no wake-up wall observed). Dark theme forced via localStorage.setItem('app_theme', JSON.stringify({themeMode:'dark'})) then reload -- confirmed works. Login post-success lands at '/' (home dashboard); do not assume '/dashboard' redirect. Sidebar exposes theme sun/moon/monitor picker on authed shell. FPS/Flappy/ContentLib routes require auth and fall into shell when unauth'd; still theme-compliant. Pricing route is /pricing (public).
rca of the issue: Original violation source: (a) audit_v2_theme_global.py hardening dropped generic @theme-ok markers, re-flagging previously reviewed lines; (b) new features (Pricing/*, FpsGameHub, FlappyBirdHub, ContentLibraryEnterprise upgrade CTA, ErrorBoundary stale --app-warning-text/--app-cyan CSS vars) shipped hardcoded hex + wrong semantic tokens (colors.bg used for text-on-primary), passing WARN-only CI. Fix applied by main agent (per problem statement): ~35 real token corrections + 3 scoped exemption tags (fixed-dark-canvas / brand-fixed-palette / deliberate-high-contrast) added to ALLOWED_THEME_OK_TAGS. Verified visually: pricing hairline borders now visible in both modes, upgrade CTA text readable on primary bg, no invisible / low-contrast text detected on any tested surface.
